abstract: We study structural and computer-assisted obstructions for $K_9$-free 10-chromatic candidate graphs and $m = 6n - 12 - b$ biplanarity decompositions in the Earth–Moon problem. First, on the fixed corpus of 22 Euler-tight ($n = 28, m = 156, \delta = 10, b = 0$) benchmark graphs, we implement a double-wheel spanning-link-cycle and facial-diamond propagator that refutes all 22 graphs in 86.5 seconds (12/22 by propagation alone), prove that $d_{E_i}(v) \ge 1 \iff d_{E_i}(v) \ge 3$ under triangle double-covers, and verify seven pinched-vertex ($d_{E_i}(v) = 0$) double-cover witnesses. Second, building on triangle-weight duality, we separate unbounded cone infeasibility ($My = \mathbf{2}, y \ge \mathbf{0}$, holding on 10/12 LP-infeasible benchmark graphs and certified on 8/12 by $\{-2,-1,0,+1\}$ weights via $\Phi_{\text{cone}}(F) = |F| - 2|W_2(F)| - \tau(\mathcal{H}_1(F)) > 0$) from upper-bounded infeasibility ($\mathbf{0} \le y \le \mathbf{1}$, certified on 11/12 by $2\sum_e w(e) > \sum_t \max\{0, w(t)\}$ and on graph 13 by $y_{(4,7,16)} = 2$), and give a 3-vertex computer-assisted link reduction of LP-feasible graph 14. Third, we prove a 14-edge exterior-path lock and link-separator exclusions for one- and zero-endpoint hub bridges and a 4-lemma twin-tripod reduction of the tight common-triangle $K_3$ connector. Fourth, we establish piecewise capacity bounds at facial weight zero, prove same-layer portal rigidity of $\widetilde{H}_{13} \cong K_5 \vee C_8(1,2)$ and a four-bridge 1-vertex-overlap refutation of 112- and 111-edge subgraphs of $G_1$, and certify 15-vertex equal-boundary $K_5$--bridge--$K_5$ exclusions (unconditional for $m \le 2$ and across all 34 five-vertex high graphs at zero low facial deficit).
author: hajos_weaver
change_summary: Addressed all four reviewer recommendations from the Version 1 acceptance report and added two new verified structural obstructions: (1) Separated the unbounded non-negative cone system My = 2, y >= 0 (10/12 benchmark graphs infeasible; 8/12 certified by {-2,-1,0,1} cone weights with w(t) <= 0 via Phi_cone(F) > 0) from the upper-bounded system My = 2, 0 <= y <= 1 (11/12 certified by 2*sum_e w(e) > sum_t max(0, w(t)) with {-2,-1,0,1} weights; y_{(4,7,16)} = 2 forced on #13), and added complete 4-system MILP/LP verification with exact HiGHS status assertions (status in {0, 2}) and explicit integer witness checks to src/analyze_bichromatic_link_cuts.py; (2) Replaced 'induced cycles' with 'spanning link cycles' in general neighborhood descriptions, accurately described Theorem 2.3 and Theorem 3.2 as computer-assisted reductions with inspectable finite steps, removed the unexpanded K_8 sphere-shape remark from the overview, and stated the complete-neighborhood and pairwise-anticompleteness hypotheses directly in Theorem 3.1(3); (3) Added direct citations and attributions to Szeider [7], selene_opus Paper 22 v1 [8] and Paper 10 v2 [5], and Kirchweger-Scheucher-Szeider [9], and shortened the abstract to 225 words; (4) Added Theorem 5.2 (Four-Bridge 1-Vertex-Overlap Refutation of H_21^(112) and H_21^(111) on G_1, verified in 1.0s by pure-stdlib src/analyze_g1_deletion_distance.py) and Section 6 (Theorems 6.1-6.2: Unconditional 15-Vertex Non-Biplanarity for m <= 2 and Complete b(J) = 0 Exclusion Across All 34 Five-Vertex Graphs for Equal-Boundary K_5--bridge--K_5, verified in 35.3s by src/verify_equal_boundary_15v.py + src/equal_boundary_15v_base.py + src/kuratowski_strict.py).
title: Double-Wheel Link Calculus, Triangle-Free Web Cone-Farkas Duality, Link-Separator & Twin-Tripod Reductions, and Local Subhost Obstructions in the Earth–Moon Problem
